scientific_intent.scientific_task: Simulate group-scaled E2M1 FP4 values while storing outputs inFloat16.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Compute max magnitude per32 values, derive power-of-two scale, normalize, round E2M1 ties-even, rescale.
invariants: Independent representable-level oracle selects nearest E2M1 magnitude with ties-even.
accuracy_requirements: All131072 widenedFloat32 outputs exact against independent CPU representable-level oracle and both references.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Half rounding, exponent-bit manipulation, group maximum and scale; zeros/subnormals/nonfinite cases not comprehensively certified.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Finite normal nonzero group maxima and128-thread blocks only; BF16/64-thread alternatives unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Microscaled low-precision tensor simulation primitive; no particular neural model or scientific workload established.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No packedstorage compression or nativeFP4 tensorcore arithmetic measured.
